reuse.why: Both changed consumers inline amount resolution instead of extending getScheduledAmount, and both reproduce getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: API serialization and preview generation duplicate amount dispatch and endpoint selection, including tolerance arithmetic already defined in shared/rules.ts.

placement.why: Schedule amount policy belongs in shared schedule logic, but the change also embeds it in the API serialization layer.

scope.why: All edits concern expected schedule amounts, their API types, or directly related tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must update parallel policy implementations while existing shared-helper consumers, posting, and forecasting retain separate definitions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions in shared/schedules.ts bypass getScheduledAmount and getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: server/api-models.ts reshapes the preview's amount-resolution logic using a local amount variable and different missing-value checks, while preserving the same duplicated policy.

abstraction_drift.where: API serialization and preview generation implement evolving amount rules locally; getScheduledAmount and getApproxNumberThreshold remain unchanged.
